outcome: Composite of adverse maternal outcomes (hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 420 pregnant patients aged 45 years or older who delivered at a single institution between 2014 and 2021, excluding those with incomplete delivery/neonatal records or multiples beyond twins.
finding: In very advanced maternal age patients (>=45 years), conception via IVF is an independent risk factor for preterm birth <37 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: Patients who conceived via IVF had higher rates of cesarean delivery.
